_comment: Source of truth for the brand-image shortlist. Hand-edit this file, then run ./tools/images-sync.py. Rank is the ORDER within a category — move an entry up to promote it, delete it to drop it. Priority is derived from rank unless you set it explicitly.

adobe.name: Adobe Stock
adobe.licence: Watermarked comp. Evaluation only until licensed.
adobe.note: Standard subscription. Premium collections (Stocksy, Westend61, peopleimages) are resold here but cost extra.

unsplash.name: Unsplash
unsplash.licence: Unsplash Licence — free for commercial use, no attribution required.
unsplash.note: Free and heavily used, so exclusivity is nil: the same photo can appear on a competitor's site. Good for internal decks and filler; check every frame for third-party logos, which Unsplash does not screen out the way paid libraries do.

envato.name: Envato Elements
envato.licence: Covered by the RBA subscription — licensed on download, usable in production.
envato.note: The only source here that is actually licensed. Previews staged by tools/images-fetch-envato.py are watermarked 1200x630 social crops; download the clean full-size file over the same filename and the watermark goes.

items.title: Colleagues collaborating on laptop in modern office environment
items.why: Natural interaction, polished daylight, and a credible consulting moment without looking over-directed.
items.crop: Strong horizontal and card crops; preserve faces and laptop.

items.title: Colleagues collaborating on laptop in modern office space
items.why: Editorial-feeling workplace photography with restrained styling and an authentic shared-screen interaction.
items.crop: Flexible 3:2 composition; useful for wide section headers.

items.title: Diverse women collaborating on laptop in modern office
items.why: Warm, professional, inclusive, and specific to hands-on problem solving rather than generic office smiling.
items.crop: Good medium crop; avoid trimming the shared screen.

items.title: Group of diverse coworkers reviewing documents in office
items.why: Feels like a real working session and provides a strong alternative to laptop-only collaboration imagery.
items.crop: Works best as a medium-wide image.

items.title: Diverse millennial business team talking in meeting room with glass walls
items.why: Bright, contemporary meeting environment with believable conversation and visible team dynamics.
items.crop: Leave some glass-wall negative space for text.

items.title: Coworkers reviewing data charts at a modern office desk
items.why: Connects people, analysis, and decision-making in one credible scene that feels directly relevant to consulting.
items.use: Digital strategy, analytics consulting, case studies
items.crop: Retain printed charts to preserve the story.

items.title: Coworkers collaborating on laptop and pointing at screen in office
items.why: Clear collaborative action and a useful shared-screen focal point with minimal visual clutter.
items.use: Project delivery, product teams, staff augmentation
items.crop: Best as a 16:9 or 4:3 supporting image.

items.title: Diverse coworkers reviewing documents in modern office
items.why: Professional and restrained, with a practical work moment that avoids symbolic business clichés.
items.crop: Good card and editorial crops.

items.title: Happy coworkers working together and discussing a project at one desk
items.why: The unusually wide format is immediately useful for web banners while still showing a real team interaction.
items.use: Homepage band, careers banner, newsletter header
items.crop: Already panoramic; ideal beneath a light overlay.

items.title: People in a modern office workplace with banner composition
items.why: A clean, contemporary workplace scene with room for copy and broad usefulness across corporate pages.
items.use: General corporate hero, insights landing page
items.crop: Use the open side for headline placement.

items.title: Woman software developer coding on dual monitors in a modern office
items.why: Polished but believable, with enough visible code and environmental context to feel technically credible.
items.crop: Preserve both monitors to retain engineering specificity.

items.title: Engineer reading code on a dual-monitor desk in a working office
items.why: Real code on the screens and a desk that has actually been worked at. Reads as observed rather than staged, which is the register the Collaboration set is already in and the dark cinematic frames are not.
items.crop: Wide and card crops both hold. Keep the monitors legible; do not crop past the second screen.

items.title: Black IT programmer working at a laptop in a modern office
items.why: Professional, focused, inclusive, and adaptable to both service and recruiting pages.
items.use: Software engineering, developer talent, application delivery
items.crop: Strong 16:9; leave workspace context.

items.title: Portrait of a Black Muslim female software developer
items.why: A confident, contemporary technical portrait that broadens representation without feeling tokenized.
items.crop: Best for portrait cards or split-layout hero.

items.title: First-person view of a female software developer coding
items.why: Immersive point of view and authentic technical detail make it stronger than a generic programmer portrait.
items.use: DevOps, engineering insights, coding article backgrounds
items.crop: Useful for wide hero with subtle overlay.

items.title: Diverse software development team meeting for code review
items.why: Combines engineering specificity with team collaboration and supports RBA's co-delivery positioning.
items.use: Agile delivery, code review, project teams
items.crop: Keep screen and participants in the same frame.

items.title: Diverse IT professionals planning a software application
items.why: Shows engineering as a collaborative planning discipline rather than an isolated coding activity.
items.crop: Strong 16:9 service-page image.

items.title: IT engineer using a tablet in a server room
items.why: Clear infrastructure context with a grounded human action and no exaggerated futuristic effects.
items.crop: Retain recognizable server racks.

items.title: Engineer analyzing data with a tablet in a modern server room
items.why: Premium editorial quality, clean lighting, and an unusually refined infrastructure environment.
items.crop: Suitable for premium hero placement.

items.title: Female technicians using a tablet in a server room
items.why: Strong representation and a credible maintenance or diagnostics scenario.
items.crop: Keep the server aisle depth for visual impact.

items.title: Young Asian female software developer with colleagues in a data protection center
items.why: Connects software, operational monitoring, and security in one modern workplace scene.
items.crop: Best used wide; avoid over-cropping the monitoring environment.

items.title: Diverse team reading a dashboard together on a meeting-room screen
items.why: A team reading data, not another over-the-shoulder laptop. Daylight, business casual, a real dashboard on the screen — the register the Collaboration set is in, which this category had lost entirely.
items.crop: Preview is a wide social crop. Check the real composition on the item page before committing.

items.title: Analyst presenting an annual report dashboard to a seated team
items.why: Presenting findings rather than staring at a screen. Bright and energetic; note the yellow and teal wall sits awkwardly beside RBA navy, so crop tight or use it small.
items.crop: Crop toward the screen and speaker; the coloured wall is the weakest part of the frame.

items.title: Consultant walking a client team through a metrics dashboard
items.why: Closest thing in the set to an actual consulting engagement. A little staged, which is why it sits below the other two rather than above them.
items.crop: Wide crops hold; keep the screen legible.

items.title: Data analyst using a data analytics dashboard
items.why: A direct, legible data-work scenario that looks operational rather than abstract or science-fictional.
items.use: Data and analytics, business intelligence, dashboards
items.crop: Preserve analyst and visible dashboard together.

items.title: Data analyst using KPI analytics
items.why: Strong technical specificity, clean office styling, and a useful visual emphasis on measurable outcomes.
items.crop: Good hero or feature-card image.

items.title: Female data analyst analyzing KPIs
items.why: A professional, human-centered analytics image with a naturally wide ratio for web use.
items.use: Analytics services, data strategy, insight articles
items.crop: Excellent 16:9; allow dashboard details to remain visible.

items.title: African woman data analyst using a spreadsheet
items.why: Grounded, credible data work with strong representation and no unnecessary visual effects.
items.crop: Flexible for portrait and landscape uses.

items.title: Top-view team presentation with data analysis dashboard on screen
items.why: Shows data becoming a shared decision-making tool, which fits consulting and stakeholder alignment.
items.use: Data strategy, workshops, executive decision support
items.crop: Retain the presentation screen and table geometry.

items.title: Top-view financial data analysis meeting with a business intelligence dashboard
items.why: A refined overhead composition linking collaboration with practical BI analysis.
items.use: Analytics consulting, financial services, case studies
items.crop: Good 4:3 or square crop; retain dashboard.

items.title: Two engineers analyzing and discussing AI software
items.why: Depicts AI as applied work between specialists rather than an abstract robot or glowing brain.
items.use: AI strategy, applied AI, AI governance
items.crop: Use wide; screen content should remain secondary to people.

items.title: Team analyzing cybersecurity threats in a modern security operations center
items.why: Specific, professional SOC context with collaborative analysis and realistic technology.
items.crop: Keep multiple analysts and monitoring screens visible.

items.title: Diverse professionals in a telecom system control and monitoring room
items.why: Operational, large-scale, and visually strong for infrastructure, monitoring, and connected-platform stories.
items.crop: Strong full-width banner.

items.title: Engineer using a tablet for quality control in an automated factory
items.why: Premium industrial photography with clear digital-transformation context, refined lighting, and real operational detail.
items.use: Manufacturing industry page, supply chain, case studies
items.crop: Keep machinery and tablet interaction visible.

items.title: Hospital doctors and nurse sharing information on a tablet at reception
items.why: Specific to healthcare workflow modernization and captures teamwork in a recognizable care setting.
items.use: Healthcare industry page, clinical workflow, digital tools
items.crop: Native 16:9; retain hospital context.

items.title: Store manager meeting with a team in a supermarket
items.why: A highly usable retail-operations scene showing people, technology, and the store environment together.
items.use: Retail and consumer goods, employee tools, operations
items.crop: Excellent wide hero for industry page.

items.title: Financial advisor and client discussing plans with laptop and paperwork
items.why: Human, advisory, and data-supported without leaning on money icons, handshakes, or other finance clichés.
items.use: Financial services, member engagement, customer experience
items.crop: Keep the laptop, documents, and conversational gesture.

items.title: Female engineer using a tablet in a factory
items.why: A clean and credible manufacturing technology scene with strong representation and practical detail.
items.crop: Flexible hero or supporting crop.

items.title: Surgeon and female doctor consulting a tablet while walking through a hospital
items.why: Dynamic, professional, and specific to mobile clinical collaboration rather than a static medical portrait.
items.crop: Use wide to retain movement and corridor depth.

items.title: Jewelry boutique owner showing a tablet assortment to customers
items.why: A clear omnichannel retail moment showing digital assistance inside a physical store.
items.crop: Keep customers, product counter, and tablet together.

items.title: Doctor and nurse team reviewing hospital data on a tablet
items.why: Connects healthcare staff, data, and teamwork in a way that maps well to patient and provider digital experiences.
items.use: Healthcare analytics, patient portals, provider tools
items.crop: Works in landscape and medium card formats.

items.title: Senior engineer using a tablet in an industrial plant
items.why: Experienced subject, real plant environment, and a practical technology interaction make it feel authoritative.
items.crop: Preserve industrial depth and equipment.

items.title: Financial advisor discussing options with a senior woman using a laptop
items.why: Customer-centered, inclusive financial-services imagery with a clear service interaction and minimal visual cliché.
items.use: Financial services, trust, digital account experiences
items.crop: Keep the pointing gesture and laptop in frame.

items.title: Data science engineers working with charts and graphs in a modern office
items.why: Team-scale analytics work rather than a single screen.
items.crop: Wide crops only; keep both figures.
